: BIH Senologie Tumorboard Empfehlung

: https://www.senologie.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/senologie-tumorboard-empfehlung : 0.10.0
Draft : Senologie_Tumorboard_Empfehlung

CarePlan für Empfehlungen der interdisziplinären Tumorkonferenz (Tumorboard)

Usages:

  • Use this Profil: Senologie Meldungs-Bundle
  • Examples for this Profil: CarePlan/Fall1-Tumorboard, CarePlan/Fall10-Tumorboard, CarePlan/Fall12-Tumorboard, CarePlan/Fall14-Tumorboard-Postop... , CarePlan/Fall14-Tumorboard-Praetherapeutisch, CarePlan/Fall2-Tumorboard-Initial, CarePlan/Fall2-Tumorboard-Progression, CarePlan/Fall4-Tumorboard, CarePlan/Fall5-Tumorboard-Neoadjuvant, CarePlan/Fall5-Tumorboard-Postoperativ, CarePlan/Fall7-Tumorboard and CarePlan/Fall9-Tumorboard

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics

.

Fixed Value: plan
